# Mental Process Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](gmeow-MentalProcessType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MentalProcessType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/mentation`](../../slices/mentation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a mental process — a closed-but-open value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses; the [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) idiom): [`gmeow:processPerception`](../individuals/gmeow-processPerception.md), [`gmeow:processAttention`](../individuals/gmeow-processAttention.md), [`gmeow:processReasoning`](../individuals/gmeow-processReasoning.md), [`gmeow:processImagining`](../individuals/gmeow-processImagining.md), [`gmeow:processDeliberation`](../individuals/gmeow-processDeliberation.md), [`gmeow:processRecollection`](../individuals/gmeow-processRecollection.md), [`gmeow:processMindWandering`](../individuals/gmeow-processMindWandering.md), [`gmeow:processDreaming`](../individuals/gmeow-processDreaming.md), [`gmeow:processLearning`](../individuals/gmeow-processLearning.md). New kinds are minted as individuals, never as subclasses of [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): no overtyping).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](gmeow-MentalProcessType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the kind of a mental process — referenced from [`gmeow:mentalProcessType`](../properties/gmeow-mentalProcessType.md) to tag an episode as perception, reasoning, imagining, dreaming, and so on (the [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) idiom).

### Avoid when

- Avoid expressing the kind as a subclass of [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md) (kinds are individuals of this class, never subclasses — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9), no overtyping) and avoid using it for the phenomenal/sub-personal distinction, which is the [`gmeow:Experience`](gmeow-Experience.md) subclass.

### How to use

- Mint each kind as a [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](gmeow-MentalProcessType.md) individual and cite it from [`gmeow:mentalProcessType`](../properties/gmeow-mentalProcessType.md) (non-functional — one reverie may be both imagining and mind-wandering); extend with new individuals rather than subclasses when a domain needs a finer kind.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:processReasoning`](../individuals/gmeow-processReasoning.md) a [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](gmeow-MentalProcessType.md).
